page.overview:
Who is Merean Redhill?

Merean Redhill (pronounced: MEH-ree-an red-hill) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah publically, and secretly a member of the Black Ajah.

She was plump and motherly with graying hair. She was 5'8 tall.

She was very strong in the One Power, with a strength of , only a little below Moiraine's ultimate strength. Few would have been her equal, and even fewer would have surpassed her.

She was Aes Sedai for more than 200 years. She was born in .
